decisions.reason: Process data archiving and reporting software fits the firm's move toward data-driven, web-based infrastructure management. It survived the 2019 pruning in which its sibling product B was dropped, which suggests it was the variant the firm chose to commit to. As software it costs little to keep on the market, so keeping the option open is justified.

Flow measurement automation software is a recent launch that aligns with the firm's digital strategy and its customer base of utility operators. Its prospects are still uncertain and maintenance costs are low, so real options reasoning favors keeping it rather than abandoning it prematurely.
